content: Cloud Functions Gen2: default timeout 60s (event-driven max 540s/9min, HTTP up to 60min), default scales to zero -> cold starts; concurrency default 80 (needs >=1 CPU), min_instances keep warm but bill idle. HTTP request size 32MB gen2, response 10MB streaming/32MB non-streaming. Global init at load time vs first-request latency. Long uploads/sync must be split into small request-response units + durable queue/worker, not one long-running function.
